text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute has built up her racing
experience
one race at a time. And
now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. It's thanks to you I was able to
run all
these races.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've grown so much. It's like I'm
actually
on my way to being a full-blown
racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through consistent work on the
fundamentals, her
racing performance
has improved considerably.
choice_data_list: ああ、目覚ましい伸びだ！
うん、目覚ましい伸びだよ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we can keep this up, this summer, we
can—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the by, Trainer. What's our next goal
race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I light up. The day has finally come I can
say these
words...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby?! Oh my word! I
wasn't
expecting that!
choice_data_list: 『ジャパンダートダービー』にしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's go with the 'Japan Dirt Derby'!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A G1 dirt race limited to classic
racers—one you
only have a single
chance to run in your whole
life... You
really think I can handle that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, be still my heart... Thank you,
Trainer.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, now we can go for it!
Yeah, we can aim for it now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And can I assume you'll be by my side,
guiding me
the whole way there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although we've made it this far, the
racers waiting
there will be the strongest
we've faced yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We won't stand a chance against them if
we don't
start training more intensely.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We should start training right away for
the Japan
Dirt Derby, then.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's something off. We've barely
started
warming up, but she's already
breathing hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's like she's already exhausted, and her

coordination's not great either.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing, I'm only a bit out of breath.
Don't
worry over little old me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has these kind of days. I'm sure
I can
just run it off...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm? About what?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um... I... I suppose I've had a few
recently...
choice_data_list: 息切れするのは今日だけ？
choice_data_list_en: Is being out of breath only happening today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging by her reaction, it seems this
may be
something more serious than a
single bad day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to get a bad feeling about
this. Our
new, self-styled intensive
training may be too
much for Wonder
Acute...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Or are we paying the price for taking it
easy until
now? Her natural abilities
have managed to carry
us this far.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's going wrong. I sleep
early,
wake up early, and I know I'm
eating right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I showed Wonder Acute
a
meal-planning app made specifically
for
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: おすすめの食事管理アプリは使ってる？
choice_data_list_en: Are you using any recommended diet apps?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She should be hitting all her nutritional
goals if
she's using it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, right... That.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's great. Thanks for telling me
about it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she's probably using it, so
the
problem shouldn't be with her diet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which, as expected, leaves us with
burnout.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer? You're not going to
suggest I take
a break from training, are
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what we should do. Is it
really okay
for us to keep training at this
pace?
choice_data_list_en: I want to. I want to, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I'm honest, I'm not confident it'll be
safe for us
to keep pushing for the Japan
Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since we're running a personalized
program, it's
difficult to get advice from
another trainer. I'm
the only one who can
make the call.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I have no idea what to do. Not one
clue...

You there, greenhorn! What seems to be
the
problem?!

Hesitate not, young one! I know nothing
of your
plight, but regardless, you must
march on!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... And who might you be?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! It is I!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The passing Overlord has deigned to
note your
situation! You may call me
T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O—a narcissist the likes of
which you
could only expect from the
ruler of the stage. It's
easy to
underestimate her at first glance, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's actually a powerhouse who's won
seven G1
races. Her vanity is not without
merit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter the challenge in front of her,
she never
gives up until she's crossed the
finish line. She's a
true king among kings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But what is she doing here?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now that I've said my greetings, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's too much of a coincidence for her to
walk by
while we're right in the middle
of a dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I ask the seven-time
winner for
some advice.
